description_en: Follows or unfollows a specified primary object
description_zh: 通过此API可以对指定的主对象执行关注或取消关注操作
name: TogglePrimaryObjectFavorite

parameters.help_en: The ID of the effective tenant
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value when type is set to mention
parameters.help_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital employee (operating object name, optional)
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称（运营对象 name，可选）
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The list of primary object business IDs
parameters.name: object_ids

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

1: Add to whitelist.
2: Remove from whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型：
1：添加白名单
2：删除白名单
parameters.name: action
